text: Hello, and welcome to live coverage of this fixture in the Premier League, as Burnley host fellow strugglers Luton Town at Turf Moor.
Vincent Kompany’s Clarets sit second-bottom of the Premier League table, following a late 3-2 defeat by Aston Villa in their last game of 2023.
They’re five points behind Everton in 17th, with the pair separated by Luton in the final relegation place, and Burnley can close the gap on their opponents to just one point with a victory here.
Luton, on the other hand, have the opportunity to climb out of the bottom three altogether at Turf Moor, as a victory would see them displace Everton in 17th.
The Hatters have won two of their last three games, but did lose the reverse fixture 2-1 at Kenilworth Road earlier in the season.
Strikers Zeki Amdouni and Lyle Foster both netted equalisers at Villa Park as Burnley looked destined to hold out for a well-earned point, but their hopes were dashed by a penalty at the death.
The pair start up front with Foster passing a late fitness test, while midfielder Josh Cullen comes in as one of three changes alongside Ameen Al Dakhil and Hjalmar Ekdal in defence.

A late fightback led by goalscorers Ross Barkley and Elijah Adebayo wasn’t quite enough to overturn a 3-2 loss to Chelsea last time out, but Luton will still be confident they can cause Burnley plenty of problems.

Jordan Clark displaces absentee Jacob Brown to join Adebayo in the forward line, while Chiedozie Ogbene starts at right-wing-back with regular Issa Kabore away with Burkina Faso on Africa Cup of Nations duty.
The teams are out on the pitch amidst ice-cold conditions at Turf Moor, and kick-off here is just moments away.
Foster kicks off for the Clarets, and we are up and running in Lancashire!
Odobert advances down the left at speed and tees up Al Dakhil on his outside, but the latter's low cross into the middle is scythed clear by Mengi covering at the near post.
Burnley are unbeaten in their last seven league games against Luton, winning four and drawing three, and are looking to complete their first league double over them since 1994-95 in the second tier.
Burnley are hosting Luton in a top-flight match for the first time since January 1975, when they won 1-0 thanks to a Billy Ingham strike.
SAVED!!! Lovely play from Burnley as Cullen, Foster and Amdouni combine to give Gudmundsson a guilt-edge chance.
He's through on goal and shoots on-target, but Kaminski makes the save at his near post before the ball is cleared away!

CHANCE!!! Luton win possession high up the other end and go within inches!!! Doughty picks Vitinho's pocket and drills the ball low across the face of goal, but Adebayo can't quite get on the end of it as he slides in at the far post!
Foster latches onto a flick-on and sets his sights on goal, but his low 25-yard drive is deflected and it's an easy save for Kaminski to make!

SAVED!!! Ogbene brings down a cross-field pass and cuts inside to tee up Barkley, whose first-time shot from the edge of the area is bending into the top corner until Trafford leaps across to tip it over the bar!
There have been three Premier League games between promoted sides Burnley, Luton and Sheffield United this season, and they've seen a combined 13 goals.
The average of 4.3 goals-per-game is the highest in matches between promoted clubs in a Premier League season, and given the flurry of end-to-end chances we've just seen, it's no wonder!
SAVED!!! Ogbene's the target of another cross-field pass and the wing-back takes on Al Dakhil on his way into the box.
He shoots from the tightest of angles, but still manages to get a well-struck effort on target and Trafford parries it behind for a corner!
After their wild 3-2 win at Sheffield United on Boxing Day, Luton are looking to pick up back-to-back top-flight away victories for the first time since December 1987 under Ray Harford.
Osho gets goal-side of Foster and dispossesses the South African on the byline, but is hammered by Foster as he launches the ball clear! Neither side is giving up much so far!
Lokonga picks out Doughty in the box and he brings the ball down for Clark, who goes down under pressure from Gudmundsson but doesn't get the penalty he's after!
Foster has gone down off the ball and is clutching his ankle in some discomfort.
That's the same issue that threatened to keep him out of this game, so we'll see if the Burnley striker is able to shake it off and carry on.
Doughty's deflected cross goes behind for a corner, which is half-cleared and picked up by Lokonga on the edge of the box.
He finds Barkley, who lets fly from 20 yards, but Odobert gets in the way and makes the block.
Burnley have lost nine of their 10 Premier League home games this season, the only side in English top-flight history to lose nine of their first 10 on home soil in a campaign.
In Football League history, only fourth-tier Newport County in 1970-71 have ever lost 10 of their first 11 at home in a season.
OVER!!! Osho takes down Foster to gift Burnley a free-kick right on the edge of their box, but Gudmundsson's effort from the dead-ball is sent high and wide of Kaminski's goalframe!
BLOCKED!!! Luton flood forward in numbers with Ogbene once again their outlet down that right-hand side.
He and Townsend combine to cross for Adebayo, and his knock-down is fired goalwards by Barkley before Cullen gets a block in!

Bell does brilliantly to ride three challenges from Burnley defenders before threading the ball through for Doughty to chase and cross, but the wing-back is flagged for offside before he can carve out a chance!
Only Sheffield United, with none, have scored fewer goals in the opening half hour of Premier League games than Luton's four so far this season.

CHANCE!!! Vitinho's cross into the Luton box causes chaos and falls to Odobert, but no-one in claret and blue is able to get a clean strike of the ball and the move ends when Lokonga is fouled by Gudmundsson!

WIDE!!! A brilliant back-to-front passing move gets Burnley out of trouble and into the final third, where Odobert cuts inside from the left, lets fly and sends a curling shot just beyond the far post!
GOOOOOAAAAALLL!!! First blood to the Clarets! Burnley break at speed as Foster charges through the middle before finding Odobert to his left.

The winger beats his marker and cuts the ball back into the area, where Amdouni pops up at the far post to stroke it home!! 1-0 to the hosts, and that could prove to be a huge goal in Burnley's fight to claw themselves out of the bottom three!

Three of Amdouni's five goal involvements in the Premier League this season have come against fellow promoted teams, and it's back-to-back first-half strikes from Burnley's Swiss striker in the last two games.
Burnley recycle possession from a cleared free-kick and Odobert stands up Townsend before crossing low as he did for the opener.
Al Dakhil's on the end of it this time though, slipping as he goes to shoot and skewing his effort wide!
BLOCKED!!! Ogbene skips clear of Al Dakhil and links up with Clark in the box.
His snap-shot from close range is blocked by Ekdal, and Al Dakhil recovers to put Lokonga's follow-up behind for a corner!
Doughty's corner is whipped right into the centre, but is met by a strong punch from Trafford as Burnley look to solidify at the back and preserve this one-goal lead.

This is the fifth time this season that Burnley have opened the scoring in a Premier League home game, however they've only managed to win one of the previous four - against Sheffield United, and losing the other three.
We'll play three additional minutes to close out the first half at Turf Moor.
Doughty fires a high, hanging cross into the area which sails over Adebayo's head and engages Trafford, but neither get a touch on the ball and it's recovered by Ogbene on the opposite side.
Ogbene's ball in from the right has both Adebayo and Trafford contesting it once more, but the Burnley keeper is clattered by the striker and it's a free-kick to the hosts.
HALF-TIME: BURNLEY 1-0 LUTON TOWN.
It's Burnley who lead this closely-fought battle at the halfway stage, up 1-0 thanks to Amdouni's opener in what's been an entertaining contest so far.
Early chances saw Gudmundsson, Barkley and Ogbene test the goalkeepers at each end, and the half continued in much the same vein, with both sides fighting for every tooth and nail.
Burnley upped the ante after the half-hour mark, though, with Odobert going close before pulling the ball back for Amdouni to fire into the back of the net.
Clark and Lokonga were both denied by the Clarets not long after, and you can bet on Luton to throw everything forward in the second half as they attempt to get back on level terms.
Amdouni's opener is the difference so far, with he and Foster giving Luton's defence a torrid time.
The Swiss striker scored from his only attempt on goal, and also completed a key pass as winning two free-kicks.
Foster has been everywhere, completing all five of his final-third passes and contesting a game-high 11 duels so far, winning three of five in the air and also completing an interception.
We're back for the second half, and it's Luton who'll kick it off through Adebayo.
SAVED!!! Burnley begin the half brightly and the ball is switched to Vitinho on the right, who cuts inside and fires a left-footed shot straight into the gloves of Kaminski!
Burnley are unbeaten in their last 10 Premier League matches when ahead at half-time, winning and drawing five apiece in a run that dates back to August 2021.
CHANCE!!! Foster frees up Odobert with an out-ball to the left, and gets the return ball in the centre of the box.
He looks to play in Amdouni to his right, but overhits the pass and it rolls beyond the striker out of play!
SAVED!!! Another Ogbene run means another cross-field pass to the wing-back, and he cuts inside looking to create shooting space before dragging a low shot across the turf and into Trafford's gloves!

WIDE!!! Cullen's reverse pass allows Vitinho to beat Doughty on both the outside and inside before opening up his body to shoot, but the Brazilian's curling effort whistles inches wide of the far post to his and the crowd's dismay!
Luton have failed to score a first-half goal in 15 of their 20 games, with only Sheffield United (17) failing to score more often in the first 45 minutes in this season's Premier League.
CHANCE!! Clark and Townsend link up on the left flank and the latter fires a cross into the middle.
Ogbene's underneath it but is knocked off-balance as he heads for goal, and Trafford tips the looping effort over the crossbar for a Luton corner!
Luton return serve after successive Doughty corners are cleared away, and the ball is moved wide by Barkley.
Ogbene is the recipient and cuts inside, but Al Dakhil gets in the way of his left-footed shot!

A well-weighted Odobert throughball sends Al Dakhil in behind the defence, but Kaminski races off his line to close the gap superbly and force the Clarets defender to run wide and behind for a goal kick.
A quick catch and throw from Trafford quashes a Luton chance and begins one for Burnley in the same motion, with Odobert coming away with possession down the left.
He passes inside to Amdouni, but a heavy touch from the goalscorer allows Bell to nip in and win the ball.
CHANCE!!! Ogbene spots the run of Adebayo and looks for him with a teasing cross into the area, but Trafford shoots off his line to gather the ball before the striker can get on the end of it.
BLOCKED!!! A Clarets counter-attack sees Burnley stream forward at pace as Amdouni finds Odobert wide.
The winger cuts inside to shoot once again, but his effort takes a big deflection off Mengi and loops goalwards before being tipped wide of the post by Kaminski!
CHANCE!!! Gudmundsson's corner is met by the head of Ekdal in the box, but a deflection takes the pace off his goalbound effort and Kaminski makes the save on his line!
The first change of the game sees Townsend withdrawn for Luton, and on comes Tahith Chong to replace him.
Chong turns on the edge of the area and lays the ball off to Barkley, but the midfielder's first-time effort strikes Cullen and bounces behind for another Luton corner.

Doughty's corner is taken well by Trafford at the far post, but the Burnley goalkeeper has picked up a knock in the process of making that catch, so play is halted until he's back to his feet and knocking the ball up-field.

Luton are unbeaten in their last seven away league games against Burnley since a 2-1 defeat in March 1995 under David Pleat, but unless they can carve out a goalscoring chance in the next 20 minutes - with a whopping 22 crosses put in so far - that record will be done and dusted.
SAVED!!! Al Dakhil strides forward from left-back and tries his luck with a speculative 25-yard shot, which Kaminski races across the face of his goal to get down to and hold!
Burnley have players queuing up on the edge of the box, but neither Clark, Lokonga nor Chong can get a shot away before the Clarets clear their lines!
Burnley counter at speed and Amdouni feeds Gudmundsson in space to his right.
The winger crosses to Foster arriving at the far post, but he can't get on the end of it as the ball skews over his head and out of play!
Another change coming in the final third for Luton, as Carlton Morris enters the fray in place of Clark.
He'll likely form a front two with Adebayo, and that should provide the Hatters with a bit more impetus in the box.
Connor Roberts also comes on in Burnley's first substitution, replacing Gudmundsson out wide.

SAVED!!! A Clarets free-kick is thumped into the box and headed back across by O'Shea towards Foster, but the South African can't repeat Amdouni's strike against Aston Villa, sending his volley straight into Kaminski's grasp!
OVER!!! Adebayo flicks Bell's forward ball down and into the path of Morris, who turns and lets fly with a 20-yard half-volley which loops up and over the bar!

CHANCE!!! There's very nearly a huge mix-up between O'Shea and Ekdal in defence for Burnley, with the Swede turning on the ball and almost taking out his centre-back partner before O'Shea recovers to clear as Adebayo closes in!
WIDE!!! Luton are pinged for offside at one end, but Burnley aren't hanging around and take a quick free-kick to send Odobert into acres of space down the right.
He carries into the box and gets around the outside of Osho, before shooting from a tight angle and slamming the ball into the side netting!
Barkley hangs up another lofted cross-field pass with Adebayo and Morris giving chase, but Trafford climbs highest to make a clean catch for Burnley.
Amdouni's goal remains the difference well into the final 10 minutes at Turf Moor, and that'll be his defining contribution as Mike Tresor comes on to replace him.
Odobert has similarly run Luton ragged at times throughout this game, and Jacob Bruun Larsen is on for the final few minutes in place of the Clarets' wideman.
Morris attempts the spectacular as he looks to get on the end of Adebayo's flick-on in the Clarets' box, but his overhead kick only results in a Burnley free-kick, for a high boot.
Luke Berry is on late as Luton throw the dice trying to get back into this game, and he'll replace Lokonga in the middle of the park.
Luton are piling plenty of numbers forward now as Bell floats a cross into the area, but Trafford's there again to make the catch - and throw the ball forward as Burnley look to break.
FIVE added minutes to play at Turf Moor with Burnley only just holding on here - can they see it out to claim a vital three points?
GOOOOOOAAAALLLL!!! It's a leveller for Luton!!! Doughty is left in yards of space and fizzes another threatening cross right into the centre of the box.

Trafford comes for it, but runs into the back of Adebayo, leaving the skies free for Morris to jump and head into the empty net!!! The home crowd and players alike are fuming, but the goal is given and it's 1-1 at Turf Moor!
Doughty's crosses haven't quite been on the money throughout this game - but that one was, and that's all that'll matter for Luton who go level in added time!
VAR had a good look at the goal, but judge that Trafford ran into Adebayo rather than being deliberately impeded.
The Burnley keeper's not happy with that, and his protests to the referee earn him a yellow card.

Jack Cork's on at the death for Burnley in place of centre-back Ekdal, but you get the feeling that the Clarets will throw absolutely everyone forward in a bid to re-gain the two points they look set to drop.
Foster gets the first touch on a long ball forward and looks to carve out a chance, but he's quickly swarmed and crowded out by Luton defenders and Bell wins possession back for the Hatters.

Claret and blue shirts flood the box as Roberts lines up a cross from the right, but his ball in is too close to Kaminski and the goalkeeper collects to thwart what could well be the game's final attacking sequence!
FULL-TIME: BURNLEY 1-1 LUTON TOWN.

An absolutely enthralling bottom-three scrap ends 1-1 at Turf Moor, with Luton drawing level just minutes from the end in highly controversial circumstances! Morris' equaliser, headed into a net vacated by the supposedly fouled Trafford, salvages a point for the Hatters which, on the balance of play, was deserved in the end.
Burnley had numerous opportunities to double their advantage, with Vitinho, Odobert, Ekdal, Al Dakhil and Foster all drawing saves from Kaminski in the Hatters' goal.

None could capitalise, though, and after Ogbene and Morris both went close at the other end for Luton, the latter rose to nod in the goal which takes Rob Edwards' side level on points with Everton in 18th.

Young Clarets goalkeeper Trafford made a habit of racing off his line to collect cross after cross from the visitors, but the one time he failed to do so proved costly for Burnley, who miss the chance to close a four-point gap on Luton and as a result remain four points - and a hefty goal difference - away from safety.
